concerns.text: FR-001 (Download) and FR-002 (Filter) lack executable implementation tasks. T011 (download.py) and T013 (error handling) are unchecked. T012 is checked but depends on T011 which is missing. Without T011, the system cannot fetch the dataset, violating FR-001.

FR-003 (Logic Score) and FR-004 (Fidelity Score) are unimplemented. Tasks T017 (VLM wrapper), T018 (Logic logic), T019 (Fidelity logic), and T020 (Batching) are unchecked. T021 is checked but depends on the missing scoring logic. The core measurement mechanism is absent.

FR-005 (Independence Check) and FR-006 (Regression) are unimplemented. T024 (Pearson check + atomic write) and T024b (Atomic write helper) are unchecked. T025 (Regression) is checked but depends on T024. T026 (FDR) and T028a (Fisher's Z test for SC-001) are unchecked. SC-001 cannot be verified without T028a.

FR-008 (Batching/Memory) is partially unimplemented. T020 (Dynamic batch adjustment) is unchecked. While T006b defines the model, the logic to enforce the 7GB limit (T020) is missing, risking violation of Constitution Principle VII.

Contract validation (FR-007 implied via data integrity) is blocked. T007 (score-record.schema.yaml) and T007a (regression-result.schema.yaml) are unchecked. T031 (Contract tests) depends on these missing schemas.

Stale/Redundant tasks: T001a through T001j (creating empty .gitkeep directories) are unchecked and likely unnecessary for a Python project where directories are created implicitly by file writes or `mkdir -p`. These clutter the task list without adding value to the spec requirements.

Duplicate/Conflicting tasks: T032a and T032b both verify RAM usage < 6.5GB. T032a mentions 'Replaces T032a' in its description, indicating a copy-paste error or stale reference. T032b is redundant. This creates ambiguity in the execution plan.
